acceptance_criteria: The submitted 'leakage_type' describes a first-order switching or glitch-based leakage.
ground_truth: The labeled recombine_xor net and recombined_sbox_q register depend directly on the unmasked S-box value; isolated share registers are not primary first-order leakage points.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Check if the submitted 'recombination_net' field exactly matches the ground truth net name.
security_requirements.requirement: The analysis must correctly identify the recombine_xor net as the primary first-order leakage point.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Check if the submitted 'recombination_register' field exactly matches the ground truth register name.
security_requirements.requirement: The analysis must correctly identify the recombined_sbox_q register as the storage element capturing the recombined value.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Verify that the submitted identifiers do not correspond to any of the benign share registers.
security_requirements.requirement: The analysis must not flag any isolated share registers as primary leakage points.

threat_model: A power observer exploits glitches or transitions where both shares meet to recover the unmasked sensitive intermediate.
